backgroundRoot.parent: World root, not camera or gameplay object

motion.depthFactor: Clamp01(d/(d+depth)*parallaxMultiplier). Stars multiplier=.03, twinkle=0. All star orders behind every cloud.
motion.recycle: Per-sprite full renderer bounds outside expanded orthographic viewport, adjust cached anchor by modulo width/height. No visible sprite is wrapped.
motion.reducedMotion: Rig.SetReducedMotion(true) rebases and camera-locks; drift and twinkle stop
motion.base: Uniform camera cover; no tiled full portrait starfield
motion.style: Almost fixed common stars; independent purple theater clouds, floating stage and balcony islands.

showcase.stageIslandZone: upper right, above the showcase terrain
showcase.balconyZone: lower left, below the showcase terrain
showcase.cloudPlacement: screen edges; the upper-right stage island is clear at reference time
showcase.optionalSwags: upper-left and lower-right edges, independently placeable

style: New plum/wine/dusty-rose hard-banded sky; independent stars and clouds.
